entities.name: Aeroflot Flight 343
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 29 September 1982, Aeroflot Flight 343, a scheduled international passenger flight flying from Moscow-Sheremetyevo Airport to Jorge Chávez International Airport, on a stopover at Luxembourg-Findel International Airport, veered off the runway, fatally injuring seven occupants. The Ilyushin Il-62M operating the flight suffered a mechanical failure.
